title: 日出时分的约书亚树沙漠

prompt._raw_prompt: 英文：Generate a panoramic desert scene at sunrise, with prominent Joshua trees casting long shadows on the sandy ground, a sky with a gradient of purple and orange as the sun rises, sparse desert vegetation, and distant rock formations. Emphasize the warm, golden morning light. 中文：生成一幅日出时的沙漠全景，显眼的约书亚树在沙地上投下长长阴影，天空随太阳升起呈现紫橙渐变，沙漠植被稀疏，远处有岩层。强调温暖的金色晨光。
